summary: decode_without_base64 failed to advance slice_start after writing accumulated bytes before an invalid percent escape, causing subsequent writes to duplicate those bytes. For data:text/plain,X%, it produces XX% instead of X%. The fix advances slice_start to the percent sign, preserving the literal invalid escape without repeating the preceding bytes. The selected dynamically named test in data-url/tests/wpt.rs consumes a regression case added by this fix to data-urls.json. No tests were executed.
